card.name: The letter K starting a name
card.fires_on: The letter K (or k) standing alone as a first piece of a proper name or word, such as place names, company names and brand names. The next piece then completes the name.

modes.label: K opening a proper name
modes.description: A capital K begins a place, organization or brand name split into pieces.

modes.label: K at sentence start or in code
modes.description: A bare K starts a sentence or follows a hyphen or slash inside a word.

card.plain: It fires when a lone letter K begins a name that is about to be finished by the next piece.
